bio: Doug Stanhope is an American stand-up comedian, author, actor, and podcast host. His stand-up material is made of vulgar, confrontational observations about everyday life.

He was born in Worcester, Massachusetts, in 1967. He began stand-up in 1990, at an open-mic night in a Las Vegas bar, and in 1995 won the San Francisco International Comedy Competition. In August 2002 he received the Strathmore Press Award for his week at the Edinburgh Festival Fringe.

He lives in Bisbee, Arizona. On 16 February 2013 he started The Doug Stanhope Podcast, recorded from home there. The public feed describes it as conversations with people he meets on the road and at home in Bisbee.

His books are Fun with Pedophiles: The Best of Baiting (Shake The Baby Press, 2006), Digging Up Mother: A Love Story and This Is Not Fame (Grand Central Publishing, 2016 and 2017), and No Encore for the Donkey (2020).
